T: Barrels of fish. Barrels of fun.
D: Bilbo and the dwarves cross Mirkwood and Lake-town to reach the dragon in the mountain.
P: Serve the mains when the dwarves are smuggled into Lake-town in Bard's fish barrels.
S: Beorn's house surrounded by giant bees
Ricotta whipped with honey and spread on toasted sourdough, drizzled with more honey and scattered with walnuts.
the dark and twisted forest of Mirkwood
Mixed mushrooms sautéed in butter with garlic and thyme, spooned onto toasted bread with shaved parmesan.
Thranduil's halls and the elves' wine cellar
Brie, blue cheese and goat's cheese on a board with red grapes, quince paste and crackers, served with a glass of red.
M: Bard smuggling the dwarves in barrels of fish
Whole snapper roasted with lemon, garlic and parsley at 200C for 25 minutes, served with roast potatoes and greens.
the dwarves' lost gold in the mountain
Pork belly slow roasted at 160C for 3 hours with honey and fennel, crackling blasted golden, with roasted apples.
W: Smaug lying on his pile of gold
Honey cake baked at 175C for 40 minutes, soaked in hot honey syrup, topped with gold leaf or sprinkles.
K: Beorn feeding the company at his long table
Milk warmed with honey and cinnamon, poured into big wooden cups.

s.note: Beorn's house surrounded by giant bees
s.how: Beat 250g ricotta with 2 tbsp honey until light and smooth. Toast thick slices of sourdough until golden and cut into fingers. Spread with the ricotta, drizzle with more honey and scatter with chopped walnuts. Serve straight away on a wooden board.

s.note: the dark and twisted forest of Mirkwood
s.how: Slice 500g mixed mushrooms and fry in butter over high heat until golden. Add crushed garlic and thyme leaves and cook another minute. Toast slices of crusty bread, spoon the mushrooms on top and finish with shaved parmesan and black pepper.

m.note: the dwarves' lost gold in the mountain
m.how: Score a 1.5kg pork belly, rub with salt and crushed fennel seeds and leave uncovered overnight. Roast at 160C for 3 hours, brushing the meat side with honey. Add halved apples for the last 40 minutes, then blast at 240C until the crackling is golden.

w.note: Smaug lying on his pile of gold
w.how: Beat 150g butter with 100g brown sugar and 150g honey, then beat in 3 eggs. Fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in a lined tin at 175C for 40 minutes. Pour over hot syrup of honey and water while still warm and finish with gold sprinkles.

d.note: Beorn feeding the company at his long table
d.how: Heat 1L milk gently until steaming but not boiling. Stir in 3 tbsp honey and a pinch of ground cinnamon until dissolved. Pour into big wooden cups or chunky mugs and dust with a little more cinnamon on top. Serve warm by the fire.
